answer: A bond of 58% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in pearl, and delta reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, a hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 73 aliases, and each one needs its own funded tide account. The attacker spends 145 dollars and 14 days per identity before it can vote at all. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
